title: skills: teach the view filter any-of group `{ or: [...] }` in the objectstack-ui list-views rule
body:
domain:ui#5 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUhKx1XHzkoikGjRB4

Filing gate: ③ the `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` line of PR #28475 (#28370), filed by the seat before ACCEPT as the claim template requires. ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the lane and grade.
Reach: an AI author writing a list view from the `objectstack-ui` skill learns only flat AND rules, so for "open, or completed in the last 7 days" it either writes two views or invents an `or` key the spec refuses.

## Wanted

- `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/list-views.md` § Filtering (≈L97) shows the any-of group: a `filter` list element `{ or: [rule, ...] }` (`ViewFilterOrGroupSchema` in `@objectstack/spec/ui`) that matches when any of its rules does; the list still ANDs it with the elements beside it. Flat rules only inside a group (no group in a group), no empty `or`. The Console builder saves its OR toggle as one group and edits a filter that is exactly one group; a group beside other conditions applies but is read-only in the builder.
- `skills/objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json`: one case (or an extended `listViews` case) whose expected output uses `{ or: [...] }` for an either-of base filter, not two views.
- Mirrors `content/docs/ui/views.mdx` § Base filter, added by PR #28475. Lands with or after PR #28475, so the skill never teaches a group the console refuses. Governed path (`skills/**`): Tier H.

Links back: #28370, PR #28475, #28020.
